summary: The liveness, well-formed-exit, and conformance checks derive every condition workflowAdmit reads over the registered definitions, and the three strands they found recover: an advancing action with no active contract refuses at the contract step except approve_contract; the complete-step correction admits one or more active contracts so a duplicated projection recovers through the same shared gate; and the operator question opens for confirm_premise on any step that declares it, so frozen ops runbooks leave their internal-SQLite cleanup step. No definition version changes.
title: The admission model derives every condition and three strands recover
